strings.intro.narration.arrival: It's the Moon Festival. {player_name} reaches the market, where the giant rabbit lantern has gone missing.
strings.intro.line.granny_greeting: Finally, a detective! My rabbit lantern has been stolen!
strings.intro.line.kit_joke: Relax, Grandma. A rabbit that big? It must have bounced off to the moon!
strings.intro.ending.a: The trail ends with the Riddle King, who was only borrowing the lantern for his riddles.
strings.intro.ending.b: Everyone has an opinion. When you finally turn round, the lantern is home again.
